_readme: Depth-damage model (audit M12, Phase 2). Built by tools/build_damage.py from the JRC global flood depth-damage database (Huizinga et al. 2017) and World Bank price series; do not edit by hand. Damage of a flooded cell = sum over asset classes of exposure (m2 of building footprint or road surface, ha of farmland) x maximum damage x damage factor(depth).

residential.label: Residential buildings
residential.note: Huizinga et al. (2017) average continental damage function for Asia (share of the maximum damage reached at each depth; linear between the points). Asia's functions come from a handful of studies (e.g. China, Indonesia, Vietnam, Bangladesh); none from Goa.

residential.label: Maximum damage, residential buildings
residential.note: Huizinga et al. (2017) India value 212.78 EUR/m2 (2010 prices, building-based: structure + content per m2 of footprint) x 60.62 INR/EUR (2010 average official rates, World Bank) x 1.863 (India GDP deflator 2024/2010, World Bank) = INR 24,035 at 2024 prices. Range: the database's 90% confidence interval (-28%/+53%). Reasoned, not solid: a regression on national construction costs, not a Goa survey.

commercial.label: Maximum damage, commercial and public buildings
commercial.note: Huizinga et al. (2017) India value 323.98 EUR/m2 (2010 prices, building-based: structure + content per m2 of footprint) x 60.62 INR/EUR (2010 average official rates, World Bank) x 1.863 (India GDP deflator 2024/2010, World Bank) = INR 36,596 at 2024 prices. Range: the database's 90% confidence interval (-31%/+35%). Reasoned, not solid: a regression on national construction costs, not a Goa survey.

industrial.label: Maximum damage, industrial buildings
industrial.note: Huizinga et al. (2017) India value 293.10 EUR/m2 (2010 prices, building-based: structure + content per m2 of footprint) x 60.62 INR/EUR (2010 average official rates, World Bank) x 1.863 (India GDP deflator 2024/2010, World Bank) = INR 33,107 at 2024 prices. Range: the database's 90% confidence interval (-30%/+53%). Reasoned, not solid: a regression on national construction costs, not a Goa survey.

agriculture.label: Maximum damage, agriculture (crop value added)
agriculture.note: Huizinga et al. (2017) India value 1146.82 EUR/ha (2010 prices, value added per ha) x 60.62 INR/EUR (2010 average official rates, World Bank) x 1.863 (India GDP deflator 2024/2010, World Bank) = INR 129,539 at 2024 prices. No interval in the database. Reasoned, not solid: a regression on national construction costs, not a Goa survey.

roads.label: Maximum damage, roads
roads.unit: INR per m2 of road surface
roads.note: Huizinga et al. (2017) India value 2.96 EUR/m2 (2010 prices, Asia average 4 EUR/m2 x India/Asia GDP per capita) x 60.62 INR/EUR (2010 average official rates, World Bank) x 1.863 (India GDP deflator 2024/2010, World Bank) = INR 335 at 2024 prices. No interval in the database. Reasoned, not solid: a regression on national construction costs, not a Goa survey.

peopleAffectedDepthM.label: Depth at which a person counts as affected
peopleAffectedDepthM.note: People living in a cell flooded deeper than this count as affected. 0.15 m is a common convention (about kerb height, where water starts entering ground floors and blocking movement), not a standard; editable. Applied to the GHS-POP people in each flooded cell.
